GONZALES, La., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Crown Crafts, Inc. (NASDAQ-CM: CRWS) (the “Company”) a producer, designer, and distributor of infant, toddler, and juvenile consumer products, today reported results for the second quarter fiscal year 2027, which ended September 27, 2026.


**Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Summary**


- Net sales of $19.0 million compared to $23.7 million in the prior-year quarter
- Gross profit margin increased to 32.0% from 27.7% in the prior-year quarter reflecting tariff refunds and severance expense recorded in the second quarter of fiscal 2027. Adjusting for these two factors, gross profit margin would have been 30.9%(1), up 320 basis points year over year
- Net income of $1.3 million, or $0.12 per share, increased from $1.2 million, or $0.11 per share in the prior-year quarter, respectively
- Declared a quarterly dividend of $0.03 per share on the Company's Series A common stock


(1) Adjusted gross margin is a non-GAAP measure. See “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” and “Reconciliation to Non-GAAP Financial Measures” below for reconciliations of non-GAAP financial measures to their most directly comparable GAAP financial measures.


“We continue to execute well on our profitability initiatives with meaningful improvement this quarter in our gross profit, marketing and administrative expenses, and year-to-date operating cash flow,” said Olivia Elliott, President and Chief Executive Officer. “In addition, we generated strong sales due in large part to the warm reception for Groovy Girls in Canada. Our stronger profitability reflects our continued initiatives around efficiency and profitability, and our talented team is simultaneously focused on the development of additional higher-margin products and sales channels to grow both sales and profitability in the quarters ahead. While we continue to make progress on longer-term initiatives including warehouse consolidation, our improved profitability and stronger cash flow are already encouraging and have helped us to significantly reduce debt and the associated interest expense while continuing to pay a dividend to our valued shareholders. Our entire team is energized by Crown Crafts’ strong positioning and the opportunities ahead to enhance shareholder value.”


**Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results**
Net sales was $19.0 million for the three-month period ended September 27, 2026 compared to $23.7 million for the three-month period ended September 28, 2025. Gross profit of $6.1 million compared to $6.6 million in the prior-year period, reflecting a gross margin of 32.0%, up from 27.7%. Cost of products sold benefitted from $0.4 million in tariff refunds and was offset by $0.2 million in severance expense during the current period, adjusting for these two items results in a gross margin on net sales of 30.9% which improved by 320 basis points year over year.


Marketing and administrative expenses were successfully reduced to $4.5 million compared to $4.7 million in the year-earlier period. Net income improved to $1.3 million, or $0.12 per diluted share, up from $1.2 million, or $0.11 per diluted share in the prior-year second quarter.


**Quarterly Cash Dividend**
The Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend on the Company’s Series A common stock of $0.03 per share, which will be paid on January 4, 2027 to stockholders of record at the close of business on December 11, 2026.

**About Crown Crafts, Inc.**
Founded in 1957, Crown Crafts, Inc. designs, markets, and distributes infant, toddler, and juvenile consumer products including infant bedding, toddler bedding, diaper bags, bibs, toys, and disposable products. The Company primarily operates through its wholly owned subsidiaries, NoJo Baby & Kids, Inc. and Sassy Baby, Inc., which market a variety of infant, toddler, and juvenile products under Company-owned trademarks (Sassy®, NoJo®, Manhattan Toy®, Baby Boom® and Neat Solutions®), as well as licensed collections and exclusive private label programs. Sales are made directly to retailers such as mass merchants, large chain stores, juvenile specialty stores, value channel stores, grocery and drug stores, restaurants, wholesale clubs, internet-based retailers and direct-to-consumers through the Company’s websites. For more information, visit www.crowncrafts.com.
